gauge.name: San Saba River near Brady

impacts.statement: Major lowland flooding will occur. No access to the picnic area at rest stop on US HWY 87. Utility pole at the rest area are partially inundated and possibly damaged.
Moderate lowland flooding will occur. Picnic area at rest stop on US HWY 87 will be inundated.
Minor lowland flooding will occur. Picnic area at rest stop off of US HWY 87 will begin flooding.

dataAttribution.title: Observations courtesy of U.S. Geological Survey

hydronotes.statement: River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 24 hours into the future from the forecast issuance time.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are issued as needed during times of high water, but are not routinely available.
